verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the core engine is well documented and corroborated. Meilisearch ships as a single dependency-free binary for Linux, macOS and Windows, with official Docker images and Helm charts, and community users run it in production at scale (up to ~80M documents on one Hetzner box). The 'same features as hosted' part is not evidenced: Cloud advertises native clusterization for read high availability, and pricing-page features like personalization and dynamic search rules are never shown as self-hostable. Community reports also note the replicated/distributed version isn't freely available and that it doesn't scale beyond a single machine. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud, self-hosted HA/clustering, clarity on whether analytics, personalization and dynamic search rules are available self-hosted.
